profile.headline: Full-stack Software Engineer | Javascript | Python | COBOL | React.js | Redux.js | Flask | SQL | Git
profile.summary: I have been a classroom teacher for the past 3 years. During that time, I became close friends with a tight knit group of software engineers which is where I gained an interested, then passion for software engineering. I was able to apply the same teaching practices and principles that I honed throughout the years to myself in order to grow as a software engineer and deepened that knowledge every day when I paired programmed and taught what I had learned to others while taking in the knowledge and experiences they had to offer. After dedicating the past 6 months to learning Javascript, Python, React.js / Redux.js, Flask, HTML5 / CSS3 and putting those skills to practice by creating several solo and group full-stack projects, I am ready to move forward and into a career in software engineering. I am eager to build on what I know while applying and solidifying the knowledge and skills I have built thus far. I can't wait to contribute to any company or organization with high expectations for their team and high quality goods/services to their consumers, especially if those consumers happen to be educators, students, or hard average, hard working americans.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed, coded, tested, and debugged software applications.

Worked closely with product managers and engineering team members to gather and refine project requirements.

Engaged in architectural and technical design discussions to guarantee scalable, maintainable, and secure solutions.

Efficiently identified and resolved software defects and performance issues, ensuring seamless operation.

positions.title: Mathematics Teacher
positions.description:
Established clear, scheduled learning objectives and demonstrated these with over 130 students

Collaborated with school’s administration to enforce rules of behavior, raise class participation to 100%, and reduce incidents of misconduct by 50%

Created flexible, effective teaching tools and methods, raising the passing score from 34% to 86%
positions.insights: Interpersonal Communication, Data Analysis and +3 skills

positions.title: Elementary School Teacher
positions.description:
Met professional obligations through efficient work habits such as: meeting deadlines, honoring schedules, coordinating efforts to better behavior, designating tasks, etc.

Administered and interpreted diagnostic screeners/curriculum-based assessments for 50% of students
positions.insights: Communication, Early Childhood Education and +3 skills
